{
  "tool": "papercusp-su:dev:pg_query",
  "arguments": {
    "sql": "SELECT wi.id AS id, p.name AS project_name, w."priority" AS priority, w.title AS title, w.type AS type, w.status AS status
FROM work_items w
JOIN plans p ON w.plan_id = p.id AND NOT p.deleted
JOIN work_item_projects wi ON w.id = wi.work_item_id AND NOT wi.deleted
WHERE w.completed_at IS NULL
ORDER BY (CASE w."priority"
  WHEN 'P0' THEN 0
  WHEN 'P1' THEN 1
  WHEN 'P2' THEN 2
  WHEN 'P3' THEN 3
  ELSE 4 END), w.created_at ASC"
  }
}
```<|mask_end|>
